title: Design Patent
short_description: Protects the unique, ornamental, and non-functional appearance of an item.
full_description: A Design Patent safeguards the visual characteristics of a product, including its shape, configuration, pattern, or surface ornamentation. It is ideal for businesses and creators who want to prevent others from copying the distinctive look of their products. While it does not cover the product's function, it ensures exclusive rights to the design, helping you maintain a competitive edge in the market.

title: Utility Patent
short_description: Protects new and useful inventions, processes, machines, and improvements.
full_description: A Utility Patent provides legal protection for inventions that are new, useful, and non-obvious. This includes processes, machines, manufactured items, or compositions of matter, as well as improvements to any of these. Utility patents are essential for inventors and companies seeking to secure exclusive rights to their technological innovations, prevent unauthorized use, and enhance the commercial value of their inventions.
